title: TutoLys play event, version 1
description: One event in a kid's play session. This file is the cross-repo contract: the Flutter app's telemetry client is validated against it in tests, and the ingest API validates every event against it. Identity fields (kid_id, org_id, device_id) are deliberately absent — they come from the JWT the backend signed and are never accepted from a payload.

schema_version.description: Version of this envelope. The ingest API accepts the current version and its predecessor.

event_id.description: Generated client-side. The idempotency key: re-sending an event with the same id is a no-op, which is what makes the app's outbox safe to retry.

event_ts.description: Client clock at the moment of the event. Kept as-is for ordering within a run; the server also records its own received_at.

exercise_run_id.description: One attempt sequence on one exercise. Null for session-level events.

skill_node_id.description: The leaf the exercise is tagged to. This is what makes a play report map onto the ministry curriculum.

attempt_index.description: 1-based within the run. Present on attempt events.

answer_payload.description: The normalized answer actually given, as ids rather than display text, so analysis never depends on wording or locale.

answer_hash.description: Stable hash of the normalized answer. Lets the rules engine tell 'repeated the same wrong answer' from 'tried different wrong answers' — a different signal about what the kid misunderstands.

kid_id.description: IGNORED. Server-controlled: whatever is sent here is overwritten with the verified JWT claim. Permitted in the payload only so a client that includes it for its own logging is not rejected — it is never read.

allOf.description: An attempt must say what was answered and whether it was right.
Exercise-scoped events must identify the exercise and its run.
